use_case: Predictive maintenance for non-safety plant equipment (anomaly detection and remaining-useful-life estimates)
business_owner: Vice President, Monitoring and Diagnostics Services
vendor_or_model: Company-built models on Cloud provider B machine learning services, plus the M&D analytics vendor's anomaly service
data_categories: Plant process data from the historian replicas (through the one-way data transfer devices); vibration and temperature from wireless sensors at Station 4 (suspended); WMS work history with technician names removed. No personal information
human_in_the_loop: An M&D engineer reviews every advisory; the system engineer decides whether to write a work request; work requests follow the normal WMS process, including the 50.65(a)(4) risk assessment before maintenance. The model cannot write to any plant system or change any preventive maintenance task
applicable_laws: 10 CFR 50.65 (work process context); 10 CFR 73.54(b)(1) and (d)(3) for new data paths near plant equipment; FTC Act Section 5 (accuracy of SL-1 claims to clients); 10 CFR Part 810 review before any use for plants outside the United States
status: In production (Stations 1 to 3 and SL-1 clients; Station 4 suspended until POAM-018 closes)
safety_or_regulatory_process_touched: Maintenance Rule monitoring (50.65(a)(1)-(a)(2)) and work management; balance-of-plant equipment whose failure could cause a reactor scram (50.65(b)(2)(iii))
subgroup_testing_status: Fleet-level only; station and equipment-class testing due 2027-01-31 (POAM-020)
monitoring: Quarterly precision, recall, and lead time by station and equipment class; missed-event review for every corrective maintenance failure on monitored equipment

use_case: Condition report screening assistant (suggests significance level and corrective action category)
vendor_or_model: Company-configured language model on Cloud provider B AI services
data_categories: Condition reports (equipment, events; may name individuals)
human_in_the_loop: The station screening committee reviews every condition report during the pilot; the assistant's suggestion is shown only after the committee's own rating is entered
applicable_laws: Corrective action program requirements of the quality assurance program (10 CFR Part 50, Appendix B, applies to safety-related activities); 10 CFR 73.77(b) CAP entries are never delayed by the assistant
subgroup_testing_status: Monthly agreement rate by significance level and by station department
monitoring: Monthly comparison of AI and committee ratings; every under-rated significant condition reviewed

vendor_or_model: EAM software vendor feature (switched on in a 2026-06 release)
human_in_the_loop: Outage schedulers accept or reject every suggestion; Technical Specification surveillance schedules are excluded from the feature
applicable_laws: 10 CFR 50.36(c)(3) (surveillance scheduling must stay accurate); 10 CFR 50.65(a)(4) (risk assessment of maintenance during outages)
safety_or_regulatory_process_touched: Outage scheduling; must not touch surveillance scheduling

use_case: Dosimetry reading anomaly flagging for technician review (SL-2 and fleet)

subgroup_testing_status: Flag rates compared across client types and dosimeter types (done 2026-03)
